name: Natural
description: A general export default. It adds only a light lift in contrast, saturation, and warmth. It does not impose a strong cast, and it leaves the footage color mostly as shot.
when_to_use: General exports that should not push a particular look; a safe default when no LUT is chosen.
ai_usage: output.look.intensity で強さを調整してよい。強い色転換を伴わないため 0.5〜1.0 のどの強度でも破綻しにくい

name: Cinematic
description: A teal-and-orange film look. Shadows lean blue-green, highlights lean orange, contrast rises, and saturation drops a little. It is a strong, stylized look.
when_to_use: Scenes that should deliberately feel like drama or film. Lower the intensity and check that skin tones hold up.
ai_usage: output.look.intensity で強さを調整してよい。強い色転換を伴うため、まず 0.5 前後から試して人物の肌色を確認し、必要なら強める

source.recipe: temperature+0.05 / contrast+0.16 / saturation-0.08 / lift_r-0.03 / lift_b+0.04 / gain_r+0.05 / gain_b-0.02

name: Warm film
description: A gentle warm film look. Blacks lift slightly, highlights lean amber, and a small saturation drop softens the hard edge of digital footage.
when_to_use: Daytime scenes of people, travel, or food that need warmth and a soft film feel.
ai_usage: 暖色化で肌の赤みが増える素材は 0.7 前後から試し、頬や白飛び付近が橙に寄りすぎないか確認する

source.recipe: temperature+0.10 / contrast-0.06 / saturation-0.03 / lift_r+0.025 / lift_g+0.020 / lift_b+0.015 / gain_r+0.050 / gain_g+0.015 / gain_b-0.025

name: Monochrome
description: A clear black-and-white look. Color is removed and contrast is tightened around the midtones.
when_to_use: Interviews, documentary, and flashback scenes where shape, light, and expression should carry the frame.
ai_usage: 完全なモノクロは 1.0。肌の陰影が硬い素材では 0.7 前後まで下げ、目元や頬の階調が潰れないか確認する

name: Silver retention
description: A silver-retention (bleach-bypass) look. Saturation drops hard, blacks and highlights tighten, and a trace of the original color remains.
when_to_use: Drama, action, and industrial scenes that need tension, bleakness, or a metallic texture.
ai_usage: 低彩度・高コントラストで肌が灰色に見えやすいため、人物では 0.5 前後から試し、血色と暗部の階調を確認する

source.recipe: contrast+0.24 / saturation-0.58 / lift_r-0.015 / lift_g-0.015 / lift_b-0.015 / gain_r+0.035 / gain_g+0.035 / gain_b+0.035

name: Vintage fade
description: Blacks lift, contrast and saturation drop, and a yellow cast makes the frame look like a faded old print.
when_to_use: Flashbacks, street walks, antiques, and lifestyle footage that should feel nostalgic or aged.
ai_usage: 黄転びと黒浮きが強く感じる人物素材は 0.6 前後から試し、肌が黄土色にならず目元の締まりが残るか確認する

source.recipe: temperature+0.12 / contrast-0.10 / saturation-0.28 / lift_r+0.060 / lift_g+0.045 / lift_b+0.025 / gain_r+0.025 / gain_g+0.010 / gain_b-0.040

name: Cool clear
description: A clean cool look. Color temperature leans blue, and a light contrast lift makes whites and air read clearer.
when_to_use: Beauty, fashion, winter, white products, and bright quiet daytime scenes.
ai_usage: 肌の赤みを穏やかに抑えるが青白く見える素材では 0.7 前後に下げ、唇と頬の血色を確認する

source.recipe: temperature-0.10 / contrast+0.08 / saturation-0.03 / lift_b+0.012 / gain_r-0.015 / gain_b+0.025

name: Night neon
description: A neon night look. Shadows lean blue-violet, and higher contrast and saturation make colored light stand out.
when_to_use: Night streets, concerts, clubs, and cyber scenes where blue, violet, and red artificial light is the subject.
ai_usage: 青紫の暗部と高彩度が肌や唇を着色しやすいため、人物では 0.4〜0.6 から試し、白目と肌の中間調を必ず確認する

source.recipe: exposure-0.08 / contrast+0.20 / saturation+0.26 / lift_r+0.025 / lift_g-0.020 / lift_b+0.060 / gain_r+0.035 / gain_g-0.010 / gain_b+0.070

name: Forest soft
description: A soft natural look. A little green is added, and contrast and saturation are held back.
when_to_use: Forests, parks, camping, and everyday vlogs that want a calm, natural feel that suits greenery.
ai_usage: 緑の反射を受けた顔では色被りが重なりやすいため 0.7 前後から試し、肌の中間調が緑へ転ばないか確認する

source.recipe: temperature-0.015 / tint-0.10 / contrast-0.04 / saturation-0.03 / lift_g+0.015 / gain_r-0.010 / gain_g+0.020

name: Sunset gold
description: A gold sunset look. Strong warmth, orange highlights, and richer saturation push the evening color.
when_to_use: Sunsets, backlight, golden hour, and warm travel or wedding shots.
ai_usage: 橙ゲインが強く肌の赤みと明部を押し上げるため、人物では 0.5〜0.7 から試し、額・頬・白い衣服の色飽和を確認する

source.recipe: temperature+0.18 / contrast+0.12 / saturation+0.12 / lift_r+0.015 / gain_r+0.090 / gain_g+0.035 / gain_b-0.060
